established: 30/36 saved cohort empirical gates fail; all retained scalar thresholds/aggregate flags agree.
Single representative 40-to-80 grid sensitivity failed; saved 80-to-120 curves meet the three numerical comparison targets.
Cell790 refined voltage still fails with passing temperature-proxy targets.
Recorded model-internal negative-particle polarization dominates the model cutoff loss.
Eight published initial/geometry scalars match the audited parameter table; no numerical transcription error established by that limited comparison.
Temperature observables differ; no casing/core temperature model is provided by the lumped node.
Several parameter laws are outside their measured temperature or stoichiometry support.
not_identified: Unique cause or fraction of each of the 30 failures attributable to cooling, inventory, diffusion, OCP, sensors, aging/history or other model error.
True ambient/fixture thermal boundary for each experiment.
Cell791 anomaly as specifically sensor failure versus real-cell behavior.
Volume-average/core temperature error or safety margin from surface-proxy agreement.
Real FPV high-C pack, ESC, motor or propeller predictive validity.

thermal_model_assumptions.allocation: Branch/shared harness heat and motor/ESC losses are energy outflows outside cell nodes. No temperature state or conductive coupling is modeled for those components.
thermal_model_assumptions.reversible_heat: Absent; consistent with a synthetic temperature-independent OCV source, insufficient for measured battery calorimetry.
thermal_model_assumptions.ambient_role: Ideal prescribed reservoir; H and airspeed coefficient are invented, not measured convection correlations.
thermal_model_assumptions.lumped_applicability: No geometry/conductivity/Biot or spatial-temperature evidence establishes uniform real-cell temperature.
qualification_corrections_required: Do not call analytical ledger closure real thermal validation.
Do not conflate per-cell H [W/K] with research-cell h [W/(m^2 K)] or transfer numerical values directly.
Do not inject all harness heat into each cell without a measured/declared thermal coupling model.

measurements: Time-synchronized current, terminal voltage, ambient air temperature next to the cell, multi-location casing temperature, sensor uncertainty/time constants and mounting details.
Independent calorimetric heat generation and heat capacity versus temperature/SOC, or independently characterized thermal relaxation with heat generation demonstrably negligible.
Fixture/contact conductance, tab leads, effective exposed area, airflow/propwash speed and orientation; core-to-surface gradient or calibrated multi-node thermal transfer.
Per-cell full conditioning/charge/hold/rest chronology, aging/storage history and calibrated coulomb count.
Independently measured active-electrode capacities/initial stoichiometries and matched OCP/entropy functions; one cell rest voltage alone is insufficient.
Qualified low-rate reference and pulse/rest profiles across temperature and SOC with electrode/kinetic support where the model exits sampled data.
Actual pack branch currents, four-wire cell/connector/lead resistances versus SOC/temperature, individual cell temperatures, and thermal coupling geometry.
Motor/ESC torque-speed-current efficiency/loss maps and dynamic step response; separate motor/ESC temperatures/cooling.
Propeller CT/CQ versus advance ratio/RPM and Reynolds conditions plus airframe inflow/propwash; held-out flight profiles at rated operating limits.

datasets.modifications: The downloaded archive is unmodified. Analysis selects the first contiguous discharge, retains the last row at duplicate timestamps, converts Celsius to Kelvin and changes discharge current to a positive magnitude. Initial cell temperature uses the preceding rest; electrode concentrations stay published and nominal ambient is used by the model. Generated comparisons, interpolated residuals and integrated metrics are derived analyses. Duplicate conflicts and source quality warnings are retained in the reports.
